T0595.title: Supplier Remote Access
T0595.definition: Remote access granted to third-party suppliers for maintenance, support, integration, or operations work.
T0595.description: Supplier remote access gives third parties entry for maintenance, support, integration, or operations and often reaches production systems, customer data, or admin consoles. Risks include shared accounts, overbroad permissions, uncontrolled access windows, and supplier compromise. Controls focus on just-in-time access, strong authentication, session recording, command auditing, and expiry.
T0595.usageExample: Assess Supplier Remote Access related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
